### 2026-10-07 – DAY 1: Figured out what I want my pcb to do, Figured out the parts i need, and got started on the schematic.

**3h**

DAY 1: Figured out what I want my pcb to do, Figured out the parts i need, and got started on the schematic.
My idea is sort of a spinoff of the starbie though it has progressed so much its hard to call it a spinoff anyway. My idea is to create a study buddy timer with one of my favorite studious anime characters on the screen. Light  Yagami from deathnote is the afformentioned studious anime character who I wish I was like. Anyway heres a really basic sketch of what i want to do

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 at 9.49.04 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WZvNxFDi6V4oKiy6xOWvyOReAv7Mf0s6/f6f8362926d2bc1c14c0d69e6efa9d88add14cc318a1808cb00ba319a1ba5b92.png)

Also i tried installing lookout onto my mac but of course my admin passwords from my dad make life 10 times harder.  Either way i moved on to the actual planning of the project. As seen above i decided to use a round screen instead of a square one and need to eventually cad a case.

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 at 9.51.18 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WZvNxFDi6V4oKiy6xOWvyOReAv7Mf0s6/a482c13c0511dcc20e2d664447bb26acbab0152a39e9ab2bc3bc9f26c81608cd.png)
thats probably the display that I am going to use.
Finally after doing the planning and trying to get the scope and nailing down the proper idea of what it is I moved on to actually trying to do the schematics of the pcb.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WZvNxFDi6V4oKiy6xOWvyOReAv7Mf0s6/c9af7604ca61583bbda16434bbcbe78880c09f71932edf1b49c591ab270eb690.png)
thats all ive got done in the last hour of work I did today the labels and stuff where kinda hard to understand and I had to get a little bit of help from my mom and i still dont know whats going on I hope to understand more tommorrow as now i have to get started on my calculus homework 😭 ALSO THE LABELS OVERLAP I HAVE NO CLUE WHAT TO DO ABOUT THAT

Today was fruitful I suppose but theres alot of room for improvement considering im a begginer i think i did well enough though. I'm genuinely going to need to pull a generational lock in if i wanna keep doing this along with my other extracurriculars while keeping my grades up.. 🥹
